about: Editorial plan for Buffer. A scheduled task reads this file from main every night and schedules what is due in the next 48 hours. Times are Europe/Berlin. Fields per post are passed to Buffer's create_post as they are; 'channel' maps to the channel id inside the task.

A board in the Shimmer block skin. Unlocks at a best score of 100,000.

A board in the Ripple block skin. Unlocks after 5,000 placed pieces.
